# Space Pirates

> A multiplayer 3D space combat game built with Babylon.js, playable in your browser.

Space Pirates is an open-source browser-based 3D space shooter featuring both single-player and real-time multiplayer modes. Originally created as a demo for the Babylon.js 5.0 release, it has evolved into a full-featured game with leaderboards, VIVERSE integration, and peer-to-peer co-op gameplay.

## Game Overview

- **Genre**: 3D Space Shooter / Arcade
- **Platform**: Web browser (desktop & mobile)
- **Engine**: Babylon.js 5.x (WebGL)
- **Multiplayer**: Real-time via Colyseus + PeerJS (P2P co-op)
- **Website**: https://www.spacepirates.app/
- **Source Code**: Open source, based on the Babylon.js Space Pirates demo

## Features

- Single-player campaign with AI enemies
- Real-time multiplayer co-op via peer-to-peer connections
- Global leaderboards tracking kills, wins, and scores
- VIVERSE platform integration for social login and avatars
- 3D space combat with ship upgrades and power-ups
- WebGL rendering with post-processing effects
- Responsive controls supporting keyboard, mouse, and gamepad

## Game Modes

- **Single Player**: Solo missions against AI-controlled enemies
- **Co-op Multiplayer**: Team up with other players in real-time P2P sessions
- **Competitive**: Compete for high scores on global leaderboards

## Controls

- **WASD / Arrow Keys**: Ship movement
- **Mouse**: Aim and shoot
- **Spacebar**: Special ability / boost
- **Gamepad**: Full controller support

## Technical Stack

- Frontend: Babylon.js 5.x, TypeScript, Webpack
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Colyseus (WebSocket game server)
- Networking: PeerJS for P2P, WebSocket for game state sync
- Auth: VIVERSE OIDC integration
- Analytics: Talo game analytics and leaderboards

## Links

- Play: https://www.spacepirates.app/
- Original Demo: https://spacepirates.babylonjs.com/
- API Documentation: https://www.spacepirates.app/openapi.yaml
